title: Retry agent_start on agent_pane_busy, bounded
action: Per D1: in execute_new, when herdr.agent_start returns an error containing agent_pane_busy (or: pane is not an available shell), retry the start up to 10 times spaced about 1 second (injected sleep seam like deliver_pointer, so tests run with no real clock); any other error keeps the current immediate spawn-failure path; exhaustion keeps the existing behavior (close the just-split pane, typed SpawnFailed). Tests: busy-twice-then-ok succeeds with exactly 3 start calls; non-busy error never retries; exhaustion closes the pane and names the retry in the message.

truths: agent_pane_busy retries bounded and succeeds when the shell warms
a non-busy start error never retries
exhaustion closes the pane with a typed message naming the retry

trace.outcome: agent start retries through the shell-boot window; the eval's own blocker is extinct

report.outcome: bounded agent_pane_busy retry (10x~1s); non-busy immediate; exhaustion keeps pane-close shape
report.tests: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee herding::run — green (44 passed) — touched module, 3 new retry tests
deviations: executed inline by the orchestrator (tiny lane allows inline): the config-route dispatch of this cell was itself blocked twice by agent_pane_busy — the bug this cell fixes; recorded as the eval finding
